leftNodes.text: So, I think episode 5 of Cowboy Bebop is my favorite. I think it's called something like Battle of Fallen Angels. It's the first main story episode where we get to meet the main antagonist Vicious. We get to see Spike's story. I honestly think it should be the first episode in the series.
leftNodes.headline: Episode5 is framed as the emotional core of Cowboy Bebop.
leftNodes.summaryLine: The entry argues this episode feels like the true start of the main story.
leftNodes.title: Episode5 is framed as the emotional core of Cowboy Bebop.
bullets: Title was remembered approximately and clarified to "Ballad of Fallen Angels.
